import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
/**
 * 统一排行榜入口
 * 指令：/排行榜
 * 列出所有排行榜类型，点击按钮进入对应排行榜
 */
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import { getBackendLeaderboardMenu } from '@src/api/bot/leaderboard-catalog';
import { FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';
export default onResponse(selects, async e => {
  const [message] = useMessage();
  const bid = e?.UserId;
  const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;

  // 不到境界也能，只是不在气泡中显示出来。减少萌新干扰

  const md = Format.createMarkdown();

  md.addText('📊 排行榜');
  md.addNewline();
  md.addNewline();

  let menu: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof getBackendLeaderboardMenu>>;

  try {
    menu = await getBackendLeaderboardMenu(bid);
  } catch (error) {
    md.addText(error instanceof Error ? error.message : '排行榜加载失败');
    void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '排行榜', content: md }));

    return;
  }

  for (const group of ['实力成长', '修仙百业', '道友互动', '竞技与活动', '其他']) {
    const items = menu.items.filter(item => item.group === group);

    if (items.length === 0) {
      continue;
    }
    md.addBold(group);
    md.addNewline();
    for (const item of items) {
      md.addButton(`[${item.label}]`, { data: item.command });
      md.addText(` — ${item.description}`);
      md.addNewline();
    }
    md.addNewline();
  }
  md.addText(menu.hint);

  void message.send(
    FormatGui({
      isPrivate,
      bid,
      title: '排行榜',
      content: md
    })
  );
});
